Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The study employs a combination of AP-MS and PCP-MS (Protein Correlation Profiling). While it uses a 'Protein Abundance Index' (PAI) for quantification, this is a form of label-free intensity-based quantification. The differential analysis focuses on the relative association of regulators (PA28, PI31, etc.) between two main proteasome subtypes (sP20S vs iP20S).
